description: Use this when the user wants to redesign their room from a photo, see a different interior style in their own home, prepare a floor-plan concept or a materials/lighting proposal, or compare ABIS styles. Returns a direct ABIS photo-upload link with optional room/style choices preserved, plus a structured photo/floorplan consulting workflow, user-selected catalog concerns, PDF and automatic sharing options. Supported needs are storage, light, circulation, care, retain and layout (at most three, only if explicitly requested). The website keeps these choices ready. Report the priorities, what to retain and what needs site review only after the actual website analysis; never diagnose an unseen photo from this public tool. No written brief is required. This tool prepares the website entry only: it does not receive photos, start generation, use image credits or expose a personal workspace. Do not use for unrelated image creation or force image design into a general information/price question.

needs.description: At most three concerns explicitly stated by the user. Catalog IDs only; never send a photo, personal details or a raw conversation.

room.description: Room selected by the user; auto when unspecified. Do not guess from a private photo.

source.description: Known client: chatgpt, claude, gemini, meta, grok, perplexity, copilot, mistral; mcp when unknown.

style.description: Style explicitly chosen by the user; recommended when unspecified. A written brief is optional on the website.
